tweets.title: Forward vs. Reverse KL Divergence: Interactive Rebuild & Modern Applications (MLE, Diffusion Distillation SDS/DMD, RLHF)
tweets.text:
Went a little back to basics today.

Whenever I needed quick clarity on Forward vs. Reverse KL divergence, I always went back to Tuan Anh Le’s classic 2017 note.

Thought of rebuilding it into something even clearer, interactive, and grounded in modern applications. How this trade-off separates MLE pretraining from Diffusion Distillation (SDS/DMD) and RLHF?

Interactive blog + live sandbox: sahilg06.github.io/blog_posts/forward-vs-reverse-kl.html
